checks.reason: Project contract keeps research computation on scheduled cloud jobs.

exact_missing_steps: Install or expose a compatible official Codex CLI on the chosen SCNet execution site.
Complete an authorized ChatGPT login on that same site and verify only `codex login status`.
Run one bounded non-research/non-data execution check for `codex exec --output-schema` under the scheduler before the fixed old32 evaluation is authorized.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not copy local auth files or tokens to SCNet.
Do not treat the logged-in Mac CLI as authorization for local research computation.
Do not infer million-row or other production capacity from CLI availability or subscription login.

official_capability_basis.boundary: Documented CLI support does not establish that either cluster has the CLI/login, and does not promise capacity for a large corpus.
official_capability_basis.source: learn.chatgpt.com/docs/non-interactive-mode lines 982-1033, as supplied and verified by root

scope: Read-only checks of regular PATH and known user bins only; no installation, authentication transfer, model call, research compute, or scheduler submission.
